@deskTxLabelAdd.description: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the pen on an Activity row or details title that has no label yet; also the ghost button in the details sub-header.

@deskTxLabelEdit.description: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the pen when the payment has a label; also the ghost button in the details sub-header.

@deskTxLabelHint.description: Placeholder of the inline label field while it is empty.

@deskTxLabelField.description: Screen-reader name of the inline label field, and the name of the field in the Details differ dialog.

@deskTxLabelAdded.description: Toast title after a label was added.

@deskTxLabelSaved.description: Toast title after a label was changed.

@deskTxLabelRemoved.description: Toast title after a label was emptied and removed.

@deskTxLabelNotSaved.description: Toast title when saving a label failed; the reason follows as its text.

@deskTxDetailsAdd.description: Ghost button in the details sub-header of a payment a scan found: opens the dialog to add what the user knows.

@deskTxDetailsEdit.description: Short ghost button in the details sub-header when details were added already.

@deskTxDetailsTitleAdd.description: Title of the dialog where the user adds details to a payment a scan found.

@deskTxDetailsTitleEdit.description: Title of the dialog when details exist already.

deskTxDetailsTip: Only for payments found by a recheck.

@deskTxDetailsTip.description: Description under the details dialog title, and tooltip on the details button: what it is for.

@deskTxDetailsFrom.description: Field name in the details dialog: who paid.

deskTxDetailsFromTip: Who paid, for your records. Not verified and never used for payment proofs.

@deskTxDetailsFromTip.description: Tooltip on the From field of the details dialog.

@deskTxDetailsFromHint.description: Placeholder of the From field in the details dialog.

deskTxDetailsFromBad: Use an Epicbox, http(s) or .onion address.

@deskTxDetailsFromBad.description: Shown under the From field when the text is not an address the wallet knows.

@deskTxDetailsNote.description: Field name in the details dialog and the details list: the private note.

@deskTxDetailsAdded.description: Toast title after details were added to a payment.

@deskTxDetailsSaved.description: Toast title after details were changed.

@deskTxDetailsRemoved.description: Toast title after every detail was cleared.

@deskTxDetailsNotSaved.description: Toast title when saving details failed; the reason follows as its text.

@deskTxManualTag.description: Tag next to a value the user typed (label, sender, method, note).

deskTxManualTip: Added by you on {date}. Not from the chain.

@deskTxManualTip.description: Tooltip on the Added by you tag when the time of the change is known.

deskTxManualTipNoDate: Added by you. Not from the chain.

@deskTxManualTipNoDate.description: Tooltip on the Added by you tag when the time of the change is not known.

deskTxManualTipFrom: Added by you on {date}. Not from the chain, not verified.

@deskTxManualTipFrom.description: Tooltip on the Added by you tag of the From value when the time of the change is known.

deskTxManualTipFromNoDate: Added by you. Not from the chain, not verified.

@deskTxManualTipFromNoDate.description: Tooltip on the Added by you tag of the From value when the time of the change is not known.

@deskHistConflictTitle.description: Title of the dialog shown when a history backup disagrees with what the user typed.

deskHistConflictLead: {n, plural, =1{The file has different details for 1 payment. Yours are kept unless you pick the file’s.} other{The file has different details for {n} payments. Yours are kept unless you pick the file’s.}}

@deskHistConflictLead.description: Description of the Details differ dialog; n payments.

@deskHistConflictMine.description: Choice card in the Details differ dialog: the value typed here.

@deskHistConflictBackup.description: Choice card in the Details differ dialog: the value in the backup file.

deskHistConflictLeadOldWallet: {n, plural, one{The old wallet’s history has different details for {n} payment. Yours are kept unless you pick the old wallet’s.} other{The old wallet’s history has different details for {n} payments. Yours are kept unless you pick the old wallet’s.}}

@deskHistConflictLeadOldWallet.description: Description of the Details differ dialog when the old wallet's history (epic-wallet) has other values than ones the user typed; n payments.

@deskHistConflictOldWallet.description: Choice card in the Details differ dialog: the value in the old wallet's history.

@deskHistConflictApply.description: Primary button in the Details differ dialog for the old wallet's history: apply the choices made.

@deskHistConflictKeepAll.description: Button in the Details differ dialog: import and keep every value the user typed.

@deskHistConflictImport.description: Primary button in the Details differ dialog: import with the choices made.

@deskHistConflictEmpty.description: Placeholder, in italics, where a value in the Details differ dialog is empty.

deskHistImportedReplaced: {n, plural, one{{n} detail replaced, the rest kept as yours.} other{{n} details replaced, the rest kept as yours.}}

@deskHistImportedReplaced.description: Line on the import result: how many typed details the user replaced with the backup's.
